title: Rafa En La Cancha
style: Latin rap with jazz-soul chords, swung boom-bap bounce, and trap-style 808 hits under a pickleball anthem; verse rides dusty Rhodes, brushed snares, and quick tongue-twisters, pre-chorus strips to bass and handclaps, chorus lifts with stacked gang vocals and chanty Spanish hooks. Rafa the rapper leads with close-mic grit, double-tracked hooks, ad-lib echoes, rim-click fills, tape-stop turns, and a warm punchy mix., jazz, soul, rap
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Paddle in my hand, I’m cool on the court
White ball pop, make it bounce, make it short
Rafa on the line, and I came for the score
Tira la bola, mira cómo voy

Backboard dreams, but the feet stay light
Two steps back, then I cut to the right
Fresh white grip and a soul so tight
Juego con el fuego, toda la night

[Pre-Chorus]
Call it out, call it out
One more shot, no doubt
Spin that thing, let it fly
Dale, dale, hasta arriba

[Chorus]
Pickle ball, pickle ball
Rafa trae el swing
Pickle ball, pickle ball
Mira cómo ring
Pega duro, pega bien
Vamos, sí, amén
Pickle ball, pickle ball
Rafa on the win

[Verse 2]
Net so low, but the pride so high
Skirt on the turn when I slide by side
Dink so sweet with a sultry glide
Baila conmigo, ven a probar

Got that drop shot kissing the line
Your whole team froze when I found my shine
Corazón fuerte, rhythm divine
Pásame otra, one more time

[Pre-Chorus]
Call it out, call it out
Hands up now, let it shout
Hold that breath, then you fly
Dale, dale, hasta arriba

[Chorus]
Pickle ball, pickle ball
Rafa trae el swing
Pickle ball, pickle ball
Mira cómo ring
Pega duro, pega bien
Vamos, sí, amén
Pickle ball, pickle ball
Rafa on the win

[Bridge]
Ay, qué sabor, qué control
One clean shot and I own the whole role
From the baseline, I dance through the pain
Suelta la mano, feel that flame

[Final Chorus]
Pickle ball, pickle ball
Rafa trae el swing
Pickle ball, pickle ball
Mira cómo ring
Pega duro, pega bien
Vamos, sí, amén
Pickle ball, pickle ball
Rafa on the win
Pickle ball, pickle ball
Rafa trae el swing
